schema_note: Site-local task closure ledger. The 48 human-selected packet rows remain verbatim and in packet order. Each implemented row is bound to a reproducible focused test. WB007-T36 uses an explicitly inferred, local-only synthetic review flow because no first-party AMC review/rating workflow was established in the authorized source evidence.

task_packet.human_selection: User explicitly selected the complete scope of the first ten sites in the supplied workbook.

priority_grouping_note: priority_group is an agent proposal by ID only; it does not rewrite or reorder task text.
implementation_gate: Implemented rows require a passing focused test binding; source-inapplicable rows require an explicit source-scope rationale.

final_disposition.rationale: The human-selected task is implemented only as an owner-bound synthetic local order review with 1-5 stars, text, and public/private local display state. It never posts to AMC or a third party. Because source behavior remains unavailable, this row is implemented and browser-tested but not directly source-compared.
